note: AFTER-TAX (net, take-home) income per source - never gross. Savings goals can be set as a percentage of this, so a gross figure here would commit money that never reaches the account; a source with basis set to anything but "net" is excluded from every calculation. effective_from/effective_to are OPTIONAL - leave both null and the entry is always in effect, which is what you want if your pay is steady. They only matter when pay changes: closing the old entry and adding a new one keeps older months accurate instead of applying today's salary retroactively. The UI's Replace button does this for you.
